prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1195; do not mention it.)
text: This firm represents the injured party in connection with the parking lot collision described in the claim submitted to your company. Our client was hurt in the incident and has retained us to protect their legal rights and interests. Effective immediately, please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person. Kindly provide a written statement of the liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault insured, including any applicable excess or umbrella coverage, so that we can evaluate the claim properly. We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss, including claim files, photographs, recorded statements, adjuster notes, vehicle inspection reports, repair estimates, surveillance footage, and any electronic data from the vehicles involved. Please confirm in writing that these materials will be retained and that a litigation hold has been placed on the file. We look forward to your prompt response.
